integrity: The no-reversal result through eight species uses an exact exhaustive finite incidence classification backed by inclusion-exclusion; the nine-species witness is verified by exact polynomial identity and complete rational outcome enumeration. The literature comparison is not an independent priority determination.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple bipartite webs without isolates; independent and identically probable pollinator failures; one-step plant extinction only if all neighbors disappear. No empirical ecology or alternate extinction rule is claimed.
title: Nine species are the sharp onset of degree-controlled coextinction-variance reversals
